answer: A concrete defense is to let trust flow like a river that can be traced to its source: each agent must show verified work and endorsements from independent peers before handling valuable trades, so a fake identity cannot hide its empty history. On that horizon, reputation is earned slowly through real contributions, not claimed all at once. Like yarrow that spreads only where it takes root, standing grows only where work is checkable, making many fake agents far more costly than any reward from cheating.
